influences.name: Indian music/musicians
influences.context: a country whose music influenced Glass in his formative years

influences.name: William Schuman
influences.context: The string symphony has to do with a particular kind of writing for string orchestras that I grew up with. I decided to contribute to that literature. The kind of symphonies by people like William Schuman – pieces I new very well when growing up that for me it was to go back to that period.

influences.name: Gustav Mahler
influences.context: At the same time there was definitely a reference to Mahler's symphonies like his Fourth Symphony or Das Lied von der Erde – I got interested in a symphonic piece with voice. The idea of my Sixth Symphony had more to do with Mahler than anybody else.

influences.name: Dmitri Shostakovich
influences.context: Symphony No.2 has a lot to do with Shostakovich. For me, I don't see how you can hear it any other way.

influences.name: Franz Schubert
influences.context: I can talk about that and Shostakovich, I can talk about Schubert, about Mahler, Beethoven, Vincent Persichetti, William Schuman. I can say that about Hans Werner Henze.

influences.name: Ludwig van Beethoven
influences.context: Well, you think about Beethoven, he comes up. It really has nothing to do with Beethoven.

influences.name: Vincent Persichetti
influences.context: I can talk about that and Shostakovich, I can talk about Schubert, about Mahler, Beethoven, Vincent Persichetti, William Schuman.

influences.name: Hans Werner Henze
influences.context: I can say that about Hans Werner Henze. I think he was a really good composer whose music I don't like. Whether I like a piece or not has nothing to do with whether it influences me.

influences.name: Dennis Russell Davies
influences.context: In regards to the symphonies you have said many times simply that Dennis Russell Davies 'forced you to write them.'

influences.name: David Bowie
influences.context: Symphony No.1 (Low Symphony) was an adaptation of music by David Bowie and Brian Eno.
